extracted.summary: Kwame Okafor asks for a call about funding options for a client, without giving any details of the matter.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance. So that we can look into this properly, we would need a few more details: the type of matter (for example divorce/financial remedy proceedings or an estate being administered), where the proceedings or estate are based, the amount of funding sought, and the value of the estate or assets in dispute. It would also help to know whether a solicitor is instructed, the firm's name, the current stage of the matter, and any upcoming hearing or tax deadline dates. Please also confirm the best contact number in full. Once we have that information a member of the team will review your enquiry and come back to you.
